overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused multi-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, catering primarily to academic and professional audiences interested in computational social science, disinformation, and social media research. Content consistently achieves high relevance and strong engagement rates across all platforms, particularly when announcing new publications, software releases (CooRnet v2.0), grants, and hiring opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new academic papers and research methodologies on coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on open-source tools like CooRnet for detecting coordinated link-sharing behavior.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Sharing upcoming conference talks, panels, and academic discussions.

recommendations: Include direct links and visual media (charts, infographics, video clips) in posts to increase click-through rates and visual appeal.
Cross-promote engagement on Bluesky and Mastodon by encouraging direct discussion threads around published research methodology.
Leverage LinkedIn's higher follower base to publish long-form posts or articles detailing grant achievements and hiring updates.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest relative engagement rate (6.14% average), with high repost volume for paper announcements and PhD opportunities, reflecting an active academic community.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated niche audience focused on methodological discussions and open-source tool updates like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the largest total engagement by volume due to a larger follower count (1,850 followers), driving high visibility for career and grant announcements.
